name: St. George Lycabettus
description: Situated in the heart of Athens, the 5-star St. George Lycabettus Hotel is just a short drive from Syntagma Square and the Acropolis Museum. Indulge in a rejuvenating experience at the on-site spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your fitness routine at the 24-hour health club or unwind in the spa tub and sauna. The hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (for a surcharge). Each of the 152 air-conditioned rooms provides a minibar, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite TV. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences comprise phones, safes, and desks. Savor Mediterranean cuisine at La Suite Lounge for lunch, dinner, or brunch. A coffee shop/café and room service (during limited hours) offer additional dining options. Unwind with a refreshing drink at the poolside bar or one of the two hotel lounges. A buffet breakfast is available daily (for a fee). For business travelers, the hotel offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Self-parking is available on-site (subject to charges).
